source: docs/specs/m1-step5c-playtest-fixes.md, Pre-registered checks (thresholds accepted by the lead, Resolved 1)
note: Pre-registered before any M1 step 5c diagnosis, measure code or sim run. Never edited after its sha256 is recorded in DECISIONS.md.
definitions: Each measure is designed and computed the same way on both sides: a pipeline module for real 2016-2023 regular season and a script for the sim's in-sample run. "Per game" is per game, not per team-game. "Gap" means the game-clock seconds between two consecutive scrimmage snaps of one drive with no timeout, period end or two-minute warning between them.

checks.measure: Postseason games, league 4242, seeds 1-10,000: games without a record, and tied games
Share of games whose last Q4 scrimmage snap is by an offense trailing by 1-8 with 1 or more timeouts and 15 s or more on the clock at the snap
Q4 final 2:00, offense trailing 1-8 with 1 or more timeouts: share of gaps of 35 s or more
Spikes snapped with the clock stopped, per game
Of games where the leader kneels in Q4, the share where the opponent then snaps in regulation
Q4 final 2:00, leading offense, defense with 0 timeouts: share of gaps of 15 s or less
Kneels in Q1, Q3, or Q2 with more than 1:00 left, per game
Field goal tries of 60+ yards, per game
Tries of 50-59 yards, per game (guards against over-correction)
Q4 final 2:00, trailing by 2 after the touchdown: two-point share of tries
Q4 final 5:00, tied after the touchdown: extra-point share of tries
Timeouts before kickoffs in Q1-Q3, per game
Timeouts before tries in Q1-Q3, per game
Timeouts before kickoffs, all periods, per game
Accepted roughing the passer on QB scrambles, per game

reportedNotGated: Reported, not gated: the playtester's "Q4 ends on a run-off by a 1-8 trailer holding timeouts" share; every `absMargin.share.*` bucket, the exact-3 margin share and the overtime-ending-on-3 share; postseason periods played per OT game.
